guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.intro:
Welcome to BitTasker! Our guidelines are designed to ensure a safe, respectful, and reliable experience for everyone.

By using our platform, you agree to uphold these standards.

1.title: 1. Posting a Task
1.item_1: Be clear and specific about what you need
1.item_2: Provide accurate location and timing requirements
1.item_5: Respond promptly to questions from taskees

2.title: 2. During Task Completion
2.item_2: Be available for questions and updates
2.item_4: Respect the taskee's time and expertise

3.title: 3. Payment and Reviews
3.item_1: Release secure payment contract funds promptly when work is completed satisfactorily
3.item_3: Address any issues through our dispute resolution process
3.item_5: Build long-term relationships based on trust

1.title: 1. Profile and Bidding
1.item_1: Complete your profile with accurate information
1.item_5: Only bid on tasks you can realistically complete

2.title: 2. Task Execution
2.item_1: Deliver work according to agreed specifications
2.item_2: Communicate progress and any issues promptly
2.item_3: Meet deadlines or negotiate changes in advance

3.title: 3. Professional Standards
3.item_4: Follow all applicable laws and regulations
3.item_5: Build long-term relationships based on trust

trust.title: Our Commitment to Trust and Safety
trust.part1:
We are committed to building a trustworthy community and will take action to protect it.
Violations of these guidelines may result in warnings, account suspension, or a permanent ban.
trust.part2:
Our algorithm also ensures that violations of our community guidelines are heavily penalized and impact your reputation and platform standing.

Thank you for being a part of BitTasker!
